envelope.title: D-119 · Send one notification per incident event
envelope.body:
A fictional recorded product decision. The quotation explains the reason; it is not a claim that this policy applies to every project.

D-119 is about Service Desk Modernization: send one notification per incident event so retries do not duplicate alerts.
